title: First brass band job with Willie Parker
summary: His first street brass band job was obtained by Willie Parker, probably with the Magnolia band; he never played with the Terminal band.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I wondered, when was the first brass band on the street that you played?
I played the first brass band I played was for the Jefferson Buzzard, it was on the Carmel Day, with Willie Parker.
He got the job for me.
Is that the Eureka band or what kind of, any name for it?
I believe that was the Magnolia band I think. I think it was the Magnolia band. I think it was.
Did you ever play with the Terminal band? No, no, no.
I never played with that band.
